name: pop-shorts-v6
doc: Retention Engine Phase 6 (docs/bible/BRAND.md R-CAP-01/02/03, R-BRAND-06): one word on screen (two when the first is a short or function word), Lilita One, thick black outline + shadow, centred in the Shorts safe zone, brand accent on the owner's *stressed* words, frame-synced starts.

safeBox.note: Shorts UI: top bar ≤ 8 %, right action rail x ≥ 86 % for y 45–88 %, title/channel/music bar y ≥ 78 %.

lanternTeal.why: matches the hero's storm-lantern glass: one brand colour for prop + captions

emberCoral.why: warm, high energy, far from Volze gold on the hue wheel

ultraViolet.why: rare on Shorts, cool and mysterious, strongest separation from skin and sky
